class.name: franka_rt_controllers/RtVelocityExecutorController
class.description: RT pure executor for Franka FR3. Reads Float64MultiArray (7 joint velocities) from a single non-RT topic, applies rate limiting and clamping, and writes to the hardware velocity interfaces at 1 kHz. No blending logic. No heap allocations, no locks, no logging in the RT path.
